  SELECT

    zadanie,

  FROM chain_stats
)
SELECT
  zadanie,
  COUNT(*) AS total_chains,
  SUM(is_success_after_retry) AS success_after_retry_chains,
  SUM(is_success_after_retry) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS share_success_after_retry,
  AVG(CASE WHEN is_success_after_retry = 1 THEN attempts_in_chain END) AS avg_attempts_in_such_chains
FROM chain_flags

WITH chain_stats AS (
    SELECT
        kod_tsepochki_zapuskov,
        zadanie,
        COUNT(*) AS attempts_count,
        MAX(CASE WHEN status = 'Успешно' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_success,
        MIN(CASE WHEN status = 'Успешно' THEN nomer_popytki ELSE NULL END) AS first_success_attempt
    FROM "08_fonovye_zadaniya"
    GROUP BY kod_tsepochki_zapuskov, zadanie
),
chain_flags AS (
    SELECT
        kod_tsepochki_zapuskov,
        zadanie,
        attempts_count,
        CASE WHEN has_success = 1 AND first_success_attempt > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_retry_success
    FROM chain_stats
)
SELECT
    zadanie,
    COUNT(*) AS total_chains,
    SUM(is_retry_success) AS retry_success_chains,
    SUM(is_retry_success) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS share_retry_success,
    AVG(CASE WHEN is_retry_success = 1 THEN attempts_count ELSE NULL END) AS avg_attempts_retry_success
FROM chain_flags
GROUP BY zadanie
ORDER BY share_retry_success DESC
